sn56.55:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso mahāpaṭhaviyā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya.
sn56.55:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ. yā vā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavīti?
sn56.55:1.4: etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ mahāpaṭhavī, appamattikā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā.
sn56.55:1.5: saṅkhampi na upenti, upanidhimpi na upenti, kalabhāgampi na upenti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittāti.
